sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Smartpress is a 100% employee-owned online printer that provides premium custom print solutions, marketing services, and fulfillment for businesses of all sizes.

Industry: Printing · Size: 250-999 · Products: Custom Print Solutions, Booklets, Mailers, Signage, Packaging, Trade Show Assets

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Smartpress scores 25 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30) and company size (9/15). Nothing was found for application fit, event engagement and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (25% similar on print, media, printing, commercial); Mactac (20% similar on print, printing, specialty, signage). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
